subject: Cloud QC-1c: web/simulators/index.html — same errant button on a redirect shim (low-pri)
description: _app/houses/web/simulators/index.html carries the same completeModule/Complete Module button, marking 'web-simulators-index' complete + copyLegacyKey('web','web-index','web-simulators-index'). It's an instant-redirect shim (<meta http-equiv=refresh content="0; url=../">) so the button is effectively unreachable in normal use, but it's dead code + same bogus-completion pattern. Web house, not cloud — left out of the Cloud QC-1 fix. Decide: remove the button (keep/adjust the legacy-key migration if it's load-bearing) or leave as harmless dead code. Verify the copyLegacyKey migration isn't relied upon before removing. Related to #189/#190.
